Our volunteer mechanics can check spokes, tension, and basic alignment while you watch and learn. Subject: Tune-ups for two-wheel commuters ahead

If your ride has been wobbling, we have room on the calendar for you. On June 3, the repair cafe is opening its benches to bicycle wheels for truing and basic spoke care. Please remember that visitors must book a slot beforehand so our volunteers can plan bench time properly.
